lines.spoken: Talent is everywhere in Africa. Opportunity isn't. Not yet.
Education is how that changes. One classroom. One scholarship. One chance to be seen.
And a life turns. Then a family. Then a community.
On November fifth, in Abuja: the African Academic Conference, and the African Academic Achievers' Awards. A four, twenty twenty-six.
This year's theme: building resilient African education systems, for inclusive growth, continental sovereignty, and global competitiveness.
Keynotes and dialogue. Live finals of the A four Debate and Spelling Bee, with five scholarships at stake. And awards for Africa's achievers.
Beyond the hall, we're launching Street to School, for children kept out of class by cost, and Repositioning Education Africa.
Our first edition drew over two hundred and fifty people, honoured twelve achievers, and put five students on scholarship.
Nominations close October twenty-fifth. Register at A four dot A E S D I dot org. And partner with us, to open more doors.
A E S D I. Reforming education. Transforming Africa.
